The Hisar Shiv Shakti Co-Op, House ... vs State Of Haryana And
Others on 20 July, 2023

Phhc:09
In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana
At Chandigarh

Date of Decision: July 20, 2023
 The Hisar Shiv Shakti Co-Op, House Building Society Ltd

entities.text: Hisar Shiv Shakti Co-Op, House Building Society Ltd
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: Through Its Secretary ........ Petitioner

Versus
 State Of Haryana And Others ........Respondents
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Harkesh Manuja

Present: Mr. G.S. Attariwala, Sr. Advocate with
 Mr. Vansh Chawla, Advocate for petitioner.
Mr. Rks Brar, Addl.AG, Haryana.

****
 Harkesh Manuja, J. (Oral)

1. By way of present petition, prayer has been made for issuance of directions to respondents to pay interest on the delayed payment of interest, beyond three months from the date of order in CWP-25477-2018 decided on 09.09.2021.
2.

As per case set up, the land of the petitioners situated in revenue estate of village Satrod, Tehsil and District Hisar came to be acquired for development of commercial Sector 25, Hisar wherein award No.28 dated 27.01.2011 was passed and market value was assessed and possession was taken over simultaneously.

3. Later, the amount of award was released in favour of petitioner-landowner on 03.05.2018 i.e.
after a gap of more than 7 years and three months.

Faced with this, the petitioner approached this Court by way of CWP-25477-2018 seeking payment of interest on delayed release of compensation amount which came to be disposed of vide order dated 09.09.2021, directing the respondents to calculate the 2023:PHHC:091348 interest in accordance with the mandate of Section 34 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and pay the same within three months.

The aforesaid exercise was carried out by the respondents and the payment of interest on delayed payment was released on 02.03.2023 i.e.
after a period of more than 15 months of the expiry of three months period as provided under the order dated 09.09.2021.
4.

At this stage, the grievance of the petitioner is that it is entitled for interest on the delayed release of the amount of interest and in this regard already approached the respondents by way of representation dated 28.04.2023 (Annexure P-5) which has not been redressed so far.
